integrations.name: Wazuh Agents
integrations.description: Endpoint agents on the approved lab systems; their status drives the monitoring-health checks of the Purple engine.

integrations.name: Alert Poller
integrations.description: Background worker that incrementally copies Wazuh alerts into PostgreSQL (checkpoint + overlap, idempotent, exponential backoff).

integrations.data_flow: Wazuh indexer wazuh-alerts-* -> PostgreSQL wazuh_alerts (every 60 s)

integrations.name: OWASP ZAP

integrations.data_flow: FastAPI -> ZAP API (lab network) -> scan -> zap_findings in PostgreSQL

integrations.name: Atomic Runner
integrations.description: Short-lived, isolated Docker container that executes approved Atomic Red Team tests on approved lab targets over SSH/WinRM.

integrations.data_flow: FastAPI -> runner broker (only holder of the Docker socket) -> runner container (lab network) -> target -> JSON result

integrations.data_flow: ZAP -> lab-web-01 nginx (access log -> Wazuh agent 002) -> Juice Shop 172.30.0.30:3000
